products.name: Ollama
products.note: Local LLM runner; self-hosted; no data exfiltration; model supply-chain verification needed

profile_text.body:
Ollama is a software company founded in 2023 that provides tooling for running open-source language models, either locally or via cloud infrastructure. The company describes itself as offering "the easiest way to automate your work using open models, while keeping your data safe," and positions its service around privacy, data locality, and throughput for agentic workloads.

The company's primary product, also called Ollama, is categorized as a local LLM runner that supports self-hosted deployments. The site states that user data is never trained on by any provider, and that cloud-hosted models are served from the US, Europe, and Singapore. The product is noted in held facts as requiring attention to model supply-chain verification as a security consideration. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are present in the available data.
